messages:
maria.g: Quick sync — we need to lock a PIR for yesterday's payment-latency incident (INC-2026). Proposing facilitator options and attendee list. Can folks indicate availability and whether they can facilitate?
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026 | Sev2 | triggered 2026-03-16T23:42Z. Customer impact: ~3% payment timeouts for 18m. Paging summary attached.
oncall-bot: Pager history: primary alex.k, secondary sam. Handoff at 00:30Z. Logs: https://redwood-pager-archive/INC-2026/pager.log
alex.k: I can facilitate Mon 2026-03-23 16:00 UTC or Tue 2026-03-24 09:00 UTC. Prefer Mon 16:00. I can prepare timeline + initial RCA notes.
sam: I can attend both but can't facilitate. Will surface any runbook gaps I saw during the incident.
jordan.r: Tue 09:00 UTC works for me, Mon 16:00 overlaps with APAC mornings — prefer Tue if possible.
liz: Can we do a 45m slot, focus on timeline + action owners? Also want product + CS in the meeting. @opslead can you confirm CS availability and customer-impact slide?
opslead: Yes — CS will join. I'll ask Elena from Support to bring any customer-facing comms. 45m is fine.
maria.g: OK — tentative plan: Mon 2026-03-23 16:00 UTC (45m) with alex.k as facilitator. If majority prefers Tue, we can move. I'll create PIR doc and pre-read. Please react with :thumbsup: to confirm availability/facilitate.
sam: :+1:
alex.k: :thumbsup: I'll run facilitation and draft the timeline section (traces + key spans).
jordan.r: :thumbsup: I'll join — will bring infra context.
oncall-bot: Ops reminder — preserve KV caches and attach a copy of /var/log/pager.log to the PIR. Export command (from node):
```
sudo tar czf /tmp/pager-logs-INC2026.tgz /var/log/pager* && aws s3 cp /tmp/pager-logs-INC2026.tgz s3://redwood-incident-archive/INC-2026/
```
maria.g: Action owners (prelim): ACTION-1: timeline writeup -> alex.k; ACTION-2: customer-impact slide -> opslead; ACTION-3: runbook gaps -> sam; ACTION-4: notify customers list -> elena. I'll add these to the tracker and keep them linked in the calendar invite.
alex.k: ACK. I'll have timeline + example traces by Mon 12:00 UTC so folks can review before the meeting.
opslead: Elena invited, product will bring @nina to cover feature context.
maria.g: Great. If no objections by EOD today I'll lock Mon 16:00 UTC and send invites with PIR doc + pre-read. Meeting guest list to include: @alex.k @sam @jordan.r @liz @opslead @elena @nina + oncall rotation leads.
liz: Works for me. Please include the 'mitigation timeline' slide in pre-read so CS has the exact customer-facing timestamps.
maria.g: Will do — booking now unless I hear conflicts. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
alex.k: Thanks — will add a 3-bullet TL;DR to the pre-read for execs.
